projects.title: LegalLM
projects.problem: An AI platform for uploading, parsing, and analyzing legal documents.
architecture: PDF, DOCX, and text uploads with structured summaries, clause and risk analysis, and document Q&A.
Answers connected to source citations and document highlighting; Gemini PDF analysis and Mammoth DOCX parsing.

projects.title: Niva / Project AIC
projects.problem: A Telegram assistant with conversational context, long-term memory, and proactive follow-ups.
architecture: FastAPI webhook handling with Gemini and Vertex AI integration.
Short-term conversational context and summarized long-term memory stored in Firestore.
keyFeatures: Proactive follow-ups and summarized conversational memory.

projects.title: LaunchSILO Labs
projects.problem: An agency platform for e-commerce, SaaS, portfolios, video production, and mobile development services.
architecture: Multi-step scope builder captures service requirements, budgets, timelines, and deliverables, with AI-assisted estimates and inquiry qualification.
Administrative CMS and inquiry pipeline with status tracking, client notes, invoices, PDF export, and WhatsApp handoffs.
keyFeatures: CMS, client inquiry tracking, and invoice exports.

projects.title: Bhudrishty
projects.problem: A landslide early-warning system developed with Team Vortiq for SIH 2026.
architecture: Independently developed the entire mobile application and contributed to the ML component and website.
Multi-source risk assessment combines sensor readings, rainfall, terrain, and satellite data for localized warnings.
keyFeatures: College nomination to present at SIH 2026 after competing among 900 teams.
